name: Brainstormer
description: Ideation assistant. Generate concepts and overcome writer's block for any project.

howToUse:
1. Type in your core topic or problem.
2. Click 'Brainstorm'.
3. Review the generated list of fresh ideas and perspectives.
4. Use these points as a foundation for your project.
features:
• Divergent Thinking
• Concept Mapping
• Perspective Discovery
